contract_admin.binding_method: Read-only code/storage at exact block; Sourcify verification record onchain bytecode equality and retrieved sources, plus Blockscout verified StRSRVotes/base. No independent recompilation or audit-clearance assertion. Sourcify match is weaker than exact_match; retained per binding.

controls.finding: Governor Anastasius points to current timelock; current timelock has Main OWNER. Governor has timelock proposer/executor/canceller roles; timelock has its own admin role. Checked legacy timelock lacks Main OWNER. No exhaustive role census or exclusivity claim.

Main is neither frozen nor issuance/trading paused at the pin. PAUSER can toggle issuance/trading pauses; SHORT_FREEZER has one use; LONG_FREEZER has finite charges; OWNER can freeze indefinitely/unfreeze and administer roles. Full current pauser/freezer membership and signer/controller census remains unsupported.

Components authorize UUPS upgrades through Main. Main authorizes self-called upgrades, with OWNER initiating version-registry-based upgradeMainTo/upgradeRTokenTo; compatible plugin validation is optional in the latter call. Owner is powerful but this is not a claim it can install arbitrary addresses directly. Version/asset-plugin registry control chains and complete allowed implementations remain unverified.

redeem/redeemTo transfer basket receipt tokens from BackingManager, not guaranteed dollars. redeemTo refreshes assets, is notFrozen and globally non-reentrant, requires full collateralization and consumes shared redemption throttle. Issuance/trading pause alone does not block it. redeemCustom also requires notFrozen and throttle, but caps requested historical-basket outputs to pro-rata available holdings and enforces caller minimums; it does not guarantee recovery at par.

Permissionless rebalance requires trading not paused/frozen, refreshed assets, no open trades, ready basket and elapsed trading delay; can sell collateral/RSR through auctions. If capital is insufficient and no recollateralization trade is available it can reduce basketsNeeded. Trading and RSR market liquidity can prevent timely recovery. Deployed BackingManager source is used: it differs from candidate head in revenue buffer rounding; no security conclusion is drawn from that difference.

StRSR seizeRSR is callable only by its BackingManager and is blocked by trading pause/freeze. Loss allocation reaches active stake, unstaking drafts and rewards; queued unstaking is not protected capital. StRSR withdrawal also requires delay maturity, ready basket and full collateralization; seizure proceeds still need market realization.

All three deployed VaultV2 sources implement maxRedeem/maxWithdraw as pure zero-return underestimates. withdraw/redeem do not use these getters as a gate: accrueInterest -> preview -> exit -> gate checks -> idle cash, then optional configured adapter deallocation -> allowance/share burn -> asset transfer. Zero getter alone proves neither illiquidity nor available cash.

For all three current Morpho receipts receiveSharesGate/sendSharesGate/receiveAssetsGate are zero, their setters abdicated; sendAssetsGate is zero but its setter is not abdicated. The verified Morpho plugin checks critical gates/abdication at construction and marks IFFY on refresh if deposit gate becomes set, escalating after default delay. This does not remove vault allocation, oracle, liquidity, asset-issuer or governance risk.

Frontier and Prime have nonzero automatic liquidityAdapter and liquidityData. Sentora PYUSD has zero liquidityAdapter and empty liquidityData: ordinary exit does not automatically pull from its other adapters; it needs sufficient idle assets or a separate deallocation path. Source exposes allocator/sentinel deallocate and permissionless forceDeallocate with adapter data, approval/share constraints and configured penalty. Adapter bytecode/market-route validity and executable withdrawal size are not certified here.

unsupported.detail: No full historical role-event replay or complete current pauser/freezer/owner/timelock membership census, signer thresholds or controller graph.
VersionRegistry and AssetPluginRegistry owner() calls reverted; other authority methods and full upstream registry graph not reviewed. No immutable-upgrade claim.
Receipt and plugin code is bound. Full Aave Pool/Comet, asset issuer, oracle proxy/feed governance, Morpho adapter/market/curator/sentinel/controller graph not recursively audited.
No withdrawal simulation, transaction, executable size/slippage proof, cash or holdings census. LMT/BM own allocation/cash financial observations.
No complete exact-version auditor-report/finding-remediation coverage map; verified source is not an audit clearance.
Current pin does not prove absence of earlier control changes or date governor/timelock migration. Historical deployed-addresses doc is 3.4.0 and not current authority evidence.
Compiler-linked library addresses are retained in verification/source records, but each linked library runtime and controller is not recursively bound or audited.
